name: OPA1655 / OPA1656
tagline: TI's 2019 Burr-Brown FET-input part: −129 dB THD+N at 20 kHz, fA current noise, 100 mA; OPA2134/OPA2604 successor.

lineage.note: Sole source. Pitched by TI E2E as next-generation OPA2134/OPA2604 replacement, not the same die.

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8 (D), marking OP1656. ID tube of 75; IDR/IDRG4 reel of 2500; G4 unexplained.
'.B' orderables Active in 2025-11-09 addendum; same package and marking; meaning unstated.
Single, SOIC-8, reel of 3000, marking OP1655. Added in Rev. B (2021-12).
SOT-23-5 (DBV), marking 2R8Q; reels of 3000/250. Preview until Rev. C (2022-09).
'.B' orderables Active in 2025-11-09 addendum; meaning unstated.
Third-party, not TI: a SOIC chip on an adapter board. TI makes no DIP.

key_specs.condition: G=1, 3.5 Vrms, 80 kHz BW; IMD ≤−134 dB

key_specs.value: 3.9 mA/ch typ, 4.6 mA max (5.0 mA max, −40 to 125 °C)
±100 mA short-circuit; swing within 0.25 V of rails
±0.5 mV typ, ±1 mV max; drift 0.3 µV/°C typ, 2 max
±10 pA typ, ±20 pA max (OPA1656; OPA1655 no max)
CMOS FET, no phase reversal; VCM V− to (V+) − 2.25 V
key_specs.condition: AOL 150–154 dB typ; CMRR 120 dB typ

reputation.summary: The modern, transparent, low-distortion Burr-Brown FET part. TI calls it the lowest-noise high-voltage CMOS op-amp (vendor claim). Reportedly: in an ASR phono noise test the €5 OPA1656 matched the €33 MUSES02; a Fosi ZA3 user said it 'wipes the floor' with Burson V7 Classic; Japanese listeners find it cleaner than OPA2134. diyAudio and AMB discuss it as an OPA1612 substitute.
typical_uses: DAC I/V, output and filter stages
Headphone amp gain and line stages (100 mA out)
Mic preamps and MM phono preamps (fA current noise)
Op-amp rolling on SOIC-to-DIP8 adapters (Fosi etc.)
Measurement buffers, tone controls, guitar/XLR interfaces
caveats: SOIC-8 only (OPA1655 also SOT-23-5); DIP rolling needs third-party adapters of variable quality.
Fast (53 MHz GBW, Zo 26 Ω at 1 MHz): adapters or weak decoupling may ring; RISO 25–50 Ω helps.
Marketed 2.9 nV/√Hz is at 10 kHz; 4.3 at 1 kHz, 11.8 at 100 Hz. Bipolars win at low impedance.
36 V maximum supply (40 V abs.): not a drop-in for OPA2604 circuits on ±20–24 V rails.
Input not rail-to-rail: VCM tops out at (V+) − 2.25 V, limiting follower headroom on low rails.

counterfeit_notes: No forensic reports. AliExpress parts are reportedly sometimes fake (low confidence). Genuine: SOIC-8 marked OP1656 (OPA1655: OP1655, SOT-23 2R8Q); every DIP is an adapter. Check about 7.8 mA per dual, pA-level bias (bipolar fakes show nA), 20 MHz, 24 V/µs.
alternatives: MUSES02 (matched on noise, ASR phono test)

revision_history.changes: Rev. *: initial release as Advance Information (preview).
Status changed from Advance Information to production data. Header 'SBOS901A - MARCH 2019 - REVISED JULY 2019'.
Added OPA1655 single as production data; retitled OPA165x.
OPA1655 SOT-23-5 (DBV) moved from preview to production. No electrical, rating or pin changes in any revision; still latest Sep 2026.
Japanese translation of SBOS901C (first issued 2019-03), served at the /jp/ symlink. Earlier JAJSH26 letters not found.

revision_chains.note: No spec changes across revisions. Rev. * and A copies identified only by title; no Rev. D.

open_questions: Confirm by header which mirrors hold Rev. * and Rev. A; check Wayback snapshots of the TI symlink.

claims_confirmed: Latest datasheet is SBOS901C, 'MARCH 2019 - REVISED SEPTEMBER 2022'; no Rev D (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa1656.pdf).
Revision history includes 'Changes from Revision A (July 2019) to Revision B (December 2021)' (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa1655.pdf).
The /jp/ symlink serves the Japanese translation (https://www.ti.com/jp/lit/ds/symlink/opa1656.pdf).
2.9 nV/√Hz, 24 V/µs, 53 MHz, 4.5–36 V, −129 dB THD+N at 20 kHz, 250 mV swing (2 kΩ), 100 mA (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1656).

OPA1655 product page and part-details pages exist (https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1655; https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1655/part-details/OPA1655DBVR; https://www.ti.com/product/OPA1656/part-details/OPA1656ID).

TI E2E FAQ names it the OPA2134/OPA2604 replacement, recommended for mic preamps and headphone drivers (https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/911603/faq-opa1656-next-generation-opa2134-and-opa2604-replacement).
AliExpress listings advertise 'New Original Non counterfeit OPA1656IDR' (https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005001795260909.html).
